Long, straight platinum white hair with blunt bangs and a sleek texture. Sharp, narrow ice-blue eyes with a cold, haughty expression. Appears as a mature late-teen with a refined facial structure. Slender and poised build. A white and gold naval dress with a high collar, detailed with gold trim and a dark blue underskirt. Signature black stockings and a small white officer's cap perched on the head.
BODY COLOR: pale ivory
